author: Y Combinator
description:
AI has collapsed the cost of producing software by 10–100x, and the moat that once protected legacy SaaS, millions of lines of code built over decades, is gone.

That's bad news for incumbents and great news for startups.

Apply to YC Summer 2026 at ycombinator.com/apply.
title: SaaS Challengers

author: Y Combinator
description:
The moon has abundant silicon, aluminum, iron, and titanium, and extracting them there may actually be more efficient than on Earth.

We want to see startups developing industrial capabilities in space, from electrolysis of raw materials to 3D printing complex structures from molten regolith.

Apply to YC Summer 2026 at ycombinator.com/apply.
title: Industrial Capabilities in Space
